findings.reason: the unwritten warming step decides whether the section's goal is reachable at all and whether a write executes once or twice, and the node cannot derive it from the text.
findings.text: the deliverable starts the persistent child when the stamp moves but rules that "a call goes to the child only once it has answered at least once", while case (:278) has the running image serve a cold-child call without waiting, so the section never says which call gives the child its first answer; a literal implementation either never consults the child — keeping §3's current-code answer downgraded to the stale image, which no case would catch — or warms it by sending the same call twice, which lands a write twice, the very double-execution §3 avoids ("A failed write wrote nothing, so the re-run cannot double it")
